items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Well, Johnny Brown used to play some time with duck owners, too.

ctx.x: Oh, you were telling me about Johnny Brown played with some band. I can't get it straight. Before the machine went on about that.

Well, Johnny Brown used to play some time with duck owners, too. Wait a minute. That was Johnny Brown. That was duck owners, clowning player. That's what I'd come to see. That's right. That was duck owners, clowning player, because he's the one who's carrying a bucket out there on the lake. That's right. That was the kind of player you used to play with. Johnny Brown. And what about the young Maple Leafs band? Who did they have on time? I can't think of them. And the old Maple Leafs band, too? The old Maple Leafs…
The old Maple Leafs band. Let's see. I think I might. Seems to me Oak Gasper had that or something.
